events.verdict: Murphy III (NOP) turns slightly as he sets the screen on Strus (CLE) and the contact is marginal.
Williamson (NOP) establishes a position in Merrill's (CLE) path and absorbs the contact.

Strus (CLE) steps into Murray's (NOP) landing area and makes illegal foot-to-foot contact. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is deemed that the contact meets the criteria for a flagrant foul penalty 1.
Mitchell (CLE) and Murphy III (NOP) briefly engage and disengage as they move off of the ball.
Merrill (CLE) briefly rests a hand on Murray's (NOP) body as he enters his shooting motion and the contact is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Mobley (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Mobley leans forward into Williamson's (NOP) arm, initiating the illegal contact during his driving shot attempt. Williamson maintains his straight-line path to the basket and does not overtly or abruptly initiate contact to Mobley.
Williamson (NOP) legally contests Harden's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Murphy III (NOP) reaches in and makes contact to the ball. The ensuing contact with Mitchell (CLE) is incidental.
Murphy III (NOP) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Strus (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Murray's (NOP) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Murphy III (NOP) lowers his arm onto Mitchell's (CLE) arms and the contact during his layup attempt is more than marginal.
Williamson (NOP) and Mitchell (CLE) get their feet tangled and both players lose their balance as a result of the incidental contact.
